messages.content: 请帮我生成一组多轮对话数据,里面包含了LLM function call

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
下面给出一组示例多轮对话数据，每条对话都包含了 LLM 的 function call（调用 `get_current_weather`）以及对应的函数返回结果。数据采用 JSON 格式，方便直接用于训练或测试。

```json
[
  [
    {"role":"user","content":"上海今天的天气如何？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"上海, 中国"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":28,\"unit\":\"celsius\",\"condition\":\"晴朗\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"上海今天晴朗，温度28°C。"},
    {"role":"user","content":"明天会下雨吗？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"上海, 中国","unit":"celsius"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":26,\"unit\":\"celsius\",\"condition\":\"多云，偶有小雨\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"明天上海多云，偶有小雨，温度26°C。"}
  ],
  [
    {"role":"user","content":"洛杉矶今天的天气怎么样？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"Los Angeles, CA"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":75,\"unit\":\"fahrenheit\",\"condition\":\"晴朗\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"洛杉矶今天晴朗，温度75°F。"},
    {"role":"user","content":"明天会下雨吗？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"Los Angeles, CA","unit":"fahrenheit"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":70,\"unit\":\"fahrenheit\",\"condition\":\"多云，偶有小雨\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"明天洛杉矶多云，偶有小雨，温度70°F。"}
  ],
  [
    {"role":"user","content":"巴黎明天的天气如何？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"Paris, France","unit":"celsius"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":18,\"unit\":\"celsius\",\"condition\":\"阴天\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"巴黎明天阴天，温度18°C。"},
    {"role":"user","content":"下周会有大雨吗？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"Paris, France","unit":"celsius"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":20,\"unit\":\"celsius\",\"condition\":\"多云，偶有雷暴\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"下周巴黎多云，偶有雷暴，温度20°C。"}
  ],
  [
    {"role":"user","content":"东京明天的天气怎么样？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"Tokyo, Japan","unit":"celsius"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":22,\"unit\":\"celsius\",\"condition\":\"多云\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"东京明天多云，温度22°C。"},
    {"role":"user","content":"今天会下雨吗？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"Tokyo, Japan","unit":"celsius"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":20,\"unit\":\"celsius\",\"condition\":\"阴天，偶有小雨\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"今天东京阴天，偶有小雨，温度20°C。"}
  ],
  [
    {"role":"user","content":"悉尼今天的天气如何？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"Sydney, AU","unit":"celsius"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":24,\"unit\":\"celsius\",\"condition\":\"晴朗\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"悉尼今天晴朗，温度24°C。"},
    {"role":"user","content":"明天会下雨吗？"},
    {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":{"location":"Sydney, AU","unit":"celsius"}}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":23,\"unit\":\"celsius\",\"condition\":\"多云，偶有小雨\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"明天悉尼多云，偶有小雨，温度23°C。"}
  ]
]
```

**说明**  
- 每条对话由若干个消息组成，消息类型包括 `user`、`assistant`、`function`。  
- `assistant` 消息中若包含 `function_call` 字段，则表示调用函数；`function` 消息中包含 `name` 与 `content`，其中 `content` 为函数返回的 JSON 字符串。  
- `arguments` 字段为 JSON 对象，包含 `location`（必填）和可选的 `unit`（默认 `fahrenheit`）。  
- 以上示例仅演示了 `get_current_weather` 函数的使用，可根据需要自行扩展或修改。
